latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Rules and Administration. (text: CR S1015-1016)

bill.title: A resolution establishing an annual Senate academic civics competition for secondary school students.

aiDescription.summary: The resolution directs the Senate Committee on Rules and Administration to establish an annual academic civics competition, promulgate necessary regulations, and permit partnerships with public or nonprofit organizations and acceptance of private donations to offset costs. It applies to secondary school students as defined in ESEA section 8101.

impact.summary: The Senate Committee on Rules and Administration would establish an annual academic civics competition for secondary school students nationwide. The Committee may partner with iCivics or the National Constitution Center, accept private donations, and issue regulations for judging and operations.
